Cleffa

Fairy

Johto · Generation 2 · Baby Pokémon

Cleffa is a Fairy-type Star Shape Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2), and is classed as a Baby Pokémon. It stands 0.3 m tall and weighs 3 kg. It evolves into Clefairy. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (55), with a base stat total of 218.
